51353497.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant biotinylated human MIF expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 DE3 by surface plasmon resonance assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using recombinant biotinylated human MIF expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 DE3 and immobilized on a streptavidin-coated sensor chip (SA). The running buffer was HBS-EP+ (10 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20, pH 7.4). Compounds were diluted in running buffer and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 μM at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. Association and dissociation phases were 180 and 120 seconds, respectively. Regeneration was achieved with 10 mM glycine-HCl (pH 2.0) for 30 seconds. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software (GE Healthcare) with a 1:1 Langmuir binding model. The dissociation constant (Kd) was calculated from the association (ka) and dissociation (kd) rate constants.
original_paragraph.Table 1: SPR Biacore Kd (μM) for p425: 9.04 ± 0.83; for L2-4048: 6.86 ± 0.77
original_paragraph.Supporting Information: The Supporting Information is available free of charge at https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acsmedchemlett.9b00351. Synthetic procedures; analytical data for intermediates 3–8 and final L2-4048 (1); biophysical assays; in vitro cellular activity studies; crystallization; and structure determination data (PDF)
